Lyngby-Tårbæk is a Danish municipality referenced in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The municipality appears in the report's detailed municipal breakdown for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke among atrial fibrillation patients via anticoagulant treatment [^src1]. Specifically, Lyngby-Tårbæk's data regarding stroke events is incorporated into the DanStroke-based calculations presented on page 93 of the report [^src1]. 

Because the available evidence for Lyngby-Tårbæk is limited to a single tabular mention in this corpus, no further historical, relational, or claim-based details are available beyond its statistical inclusion in the national clinical quality benchmarking [^src1].
